items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Joins 40 Plus Groups Launching The AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS:ADBE) joined Microsoft and more than 40 organizations to launch the AI Transparency Initiative in November 2026. The coalition aims to create independently verifiable standards so enterprises can monitor and control how AI systems behave. New guidelines focus on AI accountability and data security for businesses that use Adobe's creative and document software in regulated sectors.
